description: This script is a test suite for 'git fast-import' with signed tags, verifying behaviors with different signature formats and import options. It sets up various signed tags (OpenPGP, X.509, SSH), exports them, and tests import behavior with different '--signed-tags' modes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the enclosed commands, and reports result.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates an initial commit in the repository.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets configuration options for GPG formats and signing keys.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the enclosed command fails.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in a file or output.
